facts.business: Jindal Photo Limited is an investment holding company with income primarily from share of profit/loss of associates and fair valuation of financial assets.

auditor.name: Suresh Kumar Mittal & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on non-provision of doubtful loans and non-provision of amount recoverable from MCCL, a joint venture company, due to pending petition and claims (Note 30(c) and 30(d)).

key_risks: Non-provision of doubtful loans and recoverable amounts from MCCL (joint venture) pending legal claims
Significant share of loss from associates impacting consolidated profitability
Minimal operating cash flows and dependence on investment activities
facts.related_party_note: Share of net profit/loss of associates (Rs 2,661.94 lakhs in FY26); transactions with MCCL (joint venture) referenced in auditor's emphasis of matter.
